classes.label: Mark
classes.def: A graphical element of a diagram, as drawn: a written label, an arrow, an enclosure. A mark records what is on the sheet and carries no meaning of its own; meaning comes from the diagram's conventions. Not crm:E37_Mark, which covers signatures and similar identifying marks.

classes.label: Graphic value
classes.def: A value a mark can take on one graphical dimension.

classes.label: Ink
classes.def: The ink or medium a mark is drawn in.

classes.label: Line style
classes.def: How a drawn line is drawn: solid, dotted, dashed.

classes.label: Shape
classes.def: A shape drawn with or around a label.

classes.label: Dimension
classes.def: A positional dimension of the sheet that can carry meaning, such as vertical position against a scale.

classes.label: Convention
classes.def: A rule, valid for one diagram, that gives a graphic value (or a legend code) a meaning: 'on this diagram, graphite signifies external influence'. The same graphic value can mean different things on different diagrams, and different values can mean the same thing; conventions make both statements explicit. Every convention has a basis: stated on the sheet, or inferred by a modeller.

classes.label: Basis
classes.def: Where a convention or a reading comes from.

classes.label: Reading
classes.def: An ordering of several diagrams, with its source and basis. Order belongs to the reading, not to the diagrams: the diagrams carry no sequence of their own.

classes.label: Label mark
classes.def: A written label: at once a lexical label (its skosxl:literalForm is the wording as written) and a visual item (with ink, shape and position). Comparable to crm:E34_Inscription, which is both a linguistic object and a mark.

classes.label: Relation mark
classes.def: A mark that connects two concepts of the diagram.

classes.label: Arrow
classes.def: A directed line from one label to another.

classes.label: Enclosure
classes.def: A label written inside a shape drawn around or under another label, such as a name inside a semicircle.

classes.label: Proximity
classes.def: A label written near another and related to it by placement alone, with no line or shape joining them, such as a place written beneath a movement.

classes.label: Connector
classes.def: An undirected line, or a drawn connection whose kind cannot be assigned.

properties.label: graphic value
properties.def: A graphical property of a mark (its ink, line style, shape, or a positional dimension), or the graphical property a convention gives meaning to.

properties.label: position on scale
properties.def: The value read off the scale the diagram itself draws, at the label's position (e.g. a year on a ruled time scale). A reading of position, given meaning by the diagram's scale convention.

properties.label: position across
properties.def: Where the label sits across the sheet, read from the facsimile: 0 at the left edge, 1 at the right. Recorded as observed; no convention gives it a meaning.

properties.label: carries code
properties.def: A code from the diagram's own legend written against the label (e.g. 'p').

properties.label: holds for
properties.def: The diagram on which the convention is valid.

properties.label: applies to
properties.def: The kind of mark the convention governs (e.g. dino:LabelMark, dino:RelationMark). Absent: it governs every mark with the graphic value.

properties.label: code
properties.def: For a legend: the code the convention gives a meaning to (e.g. 'a').

properties.label: signifies
properties.def: On a convention: the meaning it gives to its graphic value or code. On a mark: the meaning that follows from the conventions of its diagram (derived by query).

properties.label: basis
properties.def: Where a convention, or a reading, comes from.

properties.label: orders
properties.def: The sheets in the order the reading proposes, as an rdf:List.

properties.label: certainty
properties.def: How securely the transcriber reads the mark: certain, probable, uncertain.

properties.label: checked on
properties.def: The date the transcription of the mark was checked against the facsimile.

properties.label: expresses
properties.def: Links a diagram to the concept scheme it expresses: the knowledge organization system the diagram is read as.

properties.label: notates
properties.def: Links a label mark to the concept of the diagram it writes. Not crm:P138_represents, which is for depiction.

properties.label: from
properties.def: The concept a relation mark starts from (the tail of an arrow; the enclosed label; the label written near another).

properties.label: to
properties.def: The concept a relation mark leads to (the head of an arrow; the enclosing or anchoring label).

properties.label: from mark
properties.def: Where a concept is written more than once on a diagram, the written label a relation mark leaves from. Each occurrence is its own label mark, with its own position; the concept stays one.

properties.label: to mark
properties.def: Where a concept is written more than once on a diagram, the written label a relation mark arrives at.

properties.label: records
properties.def: The domain relation the transcriber reads a relation mark as recording, e.g. an influence. The corresponding plain triple between the two concepts is asserted alongside.

values.label: box
values.def: A ruled frame drawn around a label.

values.label: semicircle
values.def: An arc drawn under or around a label, with other labels written inside it.

values.label: underline
values.def: A line drawn under a label.

values.label: plain
values.def: Written with no shape: recorded so that the absence of a shape is an observation, not a gap.

values.label: stated on the sheet
values.def: The diagram states the convention itself, e.g. in a legend.

values.label: inferred by the modeller
values.def: The modeller infers the convention from how the diagram is drawn.

values.label: documented
values.def: For a reading: the order is attested in the archive.

values.label: analytical
values.def: For a reading: the order is proposed in an analysis of the diagrams, by a scholar or by the modeller; it is not attested in the archive.

values.label: published
values.def: For a reading: the order is given in a publication, such as the numbering of plates. It makes no claim about chronology.

values.label: date
values.def: Position read as a date against a time scale the diagram draws.

values.label: membership
values.def: The labels enclosed belong to the group named by the label the enclosure is drawn with.

values.label: title
values.def: The label is a heading: the anchor of what is written with it.

values.label: primary
values.def: A main relation, drawn so as to stand above others (e.g. by a solid line).

values.label: secondary
values.def: A lesser relation, drawn so as to recede (e.g. by a dotted line).

values.label: no meaning
values.def: Signified by a graphic value that carries no meaning on a diagram, e.g. an ink used throughout. Stating it makes the absence of a convention an explicit judgment.

properties.label: influenced
properties.def: One concept of a chart influenced another, as an arrow on the chart asserts.

properties.label: associated with place
properties.def: A place written with a movement or a person on a chart. The chart sets the two side by side and does not say how they are related (where a movement began, where it was active, where a person worked); the property claims no more than the association.

properties.label: member of
properties.def: A person written inside a movement's semicircle: by the semicircle convention, a member of that movement.

reused.def: A drawn connection whose kind cannot be assigned. Reused from SKOS, not minted.

values.label: internal
values.def: Internal to modern art: an influence within modern art, or an entity belonging to it.

values.label: external
values.def: External to modern art: an influence from outside it, or an entity outside it.

values.label: source outside modern art
values.def: A source that feeds the chart without being a movement of modern art.

values.label: core set
values.def: Charts that write places as labels: compared by default.

values.label: secondary set
values.def: Charts that express location through areas of the page: transcribed, compared on request.
